faq.q: What is a titanium propeller pitch linkage?
faq.a: A titanium propeller pitch linkage is a precision-machined propulsion component used in controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium propeller pitch linkage?
faq.a: Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage is designed for controllable pitch propeller drive hub linkage. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium propeller pitch linkage manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Propeller Pitch Linkage is manufactured using Ring forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium propeller pitch linkage?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
